in_sanskrit.name: भद्रन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वशिकारण (bhadraN) - one who brings good fortune, शुभकामनाये (shubha-kAmanAye) - desiring good fortune or best wishes

in_hindi.name: भद्रन
in_hindi.long_meaning: शुभकामना (shubha-kAmanA) - best wishes, blessings, good fortune

in_telugu.name: భద్రన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శుభకామనే (shubha-kAmanE) - one who brings good fortune or best wishes

in_marathi.name: Bhadran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhadran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'bhadh', meaning 'to bless'. The name Bhadran signifies one who is blessed, fortunate, and endowed with good fortune.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Blessed, Fortunate
